name: Chart
description: Renders a bar, line, scatter or histogram chart from the input table and passes the table through unchanged. SVG is hand-written XML with rounded coordinates and no timestamps, so the same input produces byte-identical output; PNG is drawn with Java2D in headless mode.

file.title: Output file
file.description: Absolute path of the .svg or .png file to write; parent directories are created.

format.title: Format
format.description: svg is deterministic and golden-tested; png is drawn with Java2D.

type.title: Chart type
type.description: bar - summed values per category; line/scatter - points over a numeric x; histogram - distribution of the x column.

x.title: X column
x.description: Category column for bar; numeric column for line, scatter and histogram.

y.title: Y columns
y.description: Numeric value columns. bar takes exactly one; line and scatter take one or more (one series each); histogram takes none.

series.title: Series column
series.description: Optional column that splits values into series (one bar group, line or point colour per value); with series, y must contain exactly one column.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum input rows read for the chart.

bins.title: Histogram bins
bins.description: Number of equal-width bins for the histogram type.
